And 2 Others on 13 November, 2025 Author: Prakash Padia Bench: Prakash Padia High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:201742 High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad Writ - C No. - 37115 of 2025 M/S Piyush Refreshment Corner .....Petitioner(s) Versus State Of U.P. And 2 Others .....Respondent(s) Counsel for Petitioner(s)
texts.facts: The petitioner has preferred the present writ petition inter-alia with the prayer to direct the respondent no.2-Commissioner, Food, Safety and Drugs Administration, U.P., Lucknow to decide the stay application filed along-with appeal U/s 32-4(C) of Food, Safety and Standard Act, 2006 dated 24.09.2025 expeditiously. 3. The food safety license of the petitioner was cancelled by the respondent no.3 namely Assistant Commissioner (Food, Safety and Drugs Administration), Mathura vide order dated 12.09.2025. Aggrieved against the aforesaid statutory appeal was filed by the petitioner before the respondent no.2. Along-with the said appeal application for grant of interim relief was also filed on 24.09.2025.
texts.arguments: 4. It is argued by learned counsel for the petitioner that a considerable time has already lapsed but till date no decision has been taken on the same.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 4. It is argued by learned counsel for the petitioner that a considerable time has already lapsed but till date no decision has been taken on the same.
